commencement_date.value: Conditional: the date Landlord delivers the fully executed Lease to Tenant after both parties have signed (the Executed Lease Delivery Date). No fixed date is stated, and the lease date of July 12, 1999 is for identification only.
commencement_date.quote: The "Commencement Date" shall be the date Landlord delivers to Tenant a fully executed original copy of this Lease after Landlord and Tenant have fully executed this Lease
commencement_date.note: The Term commences on this date. The Rent Commencement Date is separate: Dec 1, 2000, subject to Landlord Delay and force majeure extension, or earlier if Tenant occupies and conducts business.

expiration_date.value: The last day of the 144th full calendar month following the Rent Commencement Date (12-year term). The Rent Commencement Date is Dec 1, 2000 unless extended for Landlord Delay or force majeure, or made earlier by Tenant occupancy. If the Buildings have different Rent Commencement Dates, the first Building's date governs.
expiration_date.quote: Expiration Date: The last day of the 144th full calendar month following the Rent Commencement Date
expiration_date.note: The date is conditional on the Rent Commencement Date. If that date is Dec 1, 2000 and is not extended, expiry would be about Nov 30, 2012. This is my calculation, not a stated date, and the lease calls for written confirmation of the dates.

initial_monthly_base_rent.value: $406,342.50 per month for Months 1-12 after the Rent Commencement Date ($2.55 per rsf per month x 159,350 rsf). The lease is triple net.
initial_monthly_base_rent.quote: Months 01 - 12: $2.55 per rentable square foot per month
initial_monthly_base_rent.note: Calculated as $2.55 x 159,350 rsf. It will change if the final rentable area differs from the approximate figure. Rent is not payable on area above 160,944 rsf.

early_termination.value: No discretionary early termination right is given to Tenant. It has only contingent termination rights: (1) construction-related rights under Section 2.3 (Landlord fails to start base building work within 180 days, construction stops for more than 150 days, or the Base Building Work is not complete by the June 1, 2001 Outside Date); (2) casualty (Section 12.3); (3) condemnation (Section 13); (4) Hazardous Materials, if more than 20% of the Premises is unusable for 12 months (Section 5.2(h)); and (5) service interruption of 180 days (Section 9.2). No termination fee is stated.
early_termination.normalised: No voluntary termination option; only contingent rights (construction delay, casualty, condemnation, hazardous materials, service failure)
early_termination.quote: then Tenant may deliver a notice to Landlord ("Cessation of Construction Termination Notice") electing to terminate this Lease effective on Landlord's receipt of such notice;
early_termination.note: Section 42 (Guaranty and Conditions to Termination of Guaranty) concerns the guaranty and not termination of the lease. Its text is not provided.
